description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Thopter Squadron's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two 1/1 Thopter artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Thopter, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Thopter Squadron's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Thopter, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2

uses.name: Thopter Squadron
uses.cardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

uses.name: Kaya, Geist Hunter
uses.cardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it
